name: Cloudflare Workers AI
short: Serverless inference for open models inside Workers, metered in Neurons with a daily free allocation and AI Gateway billing.

plans.name: Workers Free
plans.notes: Generates a Cloudflare API Token for local development via the OpenAI-compatible REST endpoint (api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{id}/ai/v1/chat/completions). 10,000 Neurons/day reset daily at 00:00 UTC without a credit card.

plans.name: Workers Paid
plans.notes: First 10,000 Neurons/day stay free; some frontier models require a paid billing method or AI Gateway credits.
